test_title: SSC MTS (2022) Official Paper (Held On: 17 May, 2023 Shift 2)
subject: general
question: 14 people can do work in 28 days. In how many days, can 8 people complete double the work?
solution:
Given:

Men = 14

Time = 28 days

Formula used:

Work = Number of days (Time) (T or D) × Number of men (M). 

M1 × D1 = M2 × D2

Calculation

Total work done by 14 people = 14 × 28

⇒ 392

Let the number of days by 8 men to do double the work be D2.

⇒ 392 × 2 = 8 × D2

⇒ D2 = 49 × 2

⇒ D2 = 98 days

**∴ Number of days required is 98.**
